expectations.buyer: Connected-product users, industrial fleet operators, OEM data-service teams, integrators, and Data Act dispute or compliance owners
expectations.pain: A statutory machine-data feed exists contractually but is stale, incomplete, unstable, semantically unusable, or unavailable when operations depend on it
expectations.strongestIncumbent: OEM portals and APIs, cloud IoT observability, OPC UA and MQTT tooling, data contracts, integration monitoring, and statutory dispute channels
expectations.biggestRisk: No explicit service level may exist, derived data may be out of scope, observability is already bundled, and buyers need endpoint access before value can be measured
